summary: Audited all 180 original string pairs. Corrections address beef-belly mistranslations, an unsupported soy reference, egg-doneness wording, menu phrasing, and orthography. During review, English gained ui.photoNote and now has 181 keys; its missing translation is included below. Placeholders, numbers, and required names match across the 180 paired entries.

terminologyNotes: Standardize beef belly as 'panceta de res'. Mexican 'panza' denotes stomach/tripe; 'panceta de res' is attested for beef belly. See [Larousse](https://laroussecocina.mx/palabra/panza/) and [Sociedad Mexicana de Parrilleros](https://smpgrill.com/es/blogs/novedades). Do not substitute a more specific butcher's cut without confirmation.

'Nueces de árbol' provides an explicit US allergen-category label, also used by [FARE](https://www.foodallergy.org/our-initiatives/awareness-campaigns/ready-act/listo-para-actuar). FDA Spanish materials also use 'frutos secos'; this proposed change is for clarity.

'Mariscos' preserves the supplied English 'Shellfish'. The formal FDA category is crustacean shellfish. Any narrowing to 'Crustáceos' should follow a coordinated review of the English label and underlying tags. See [FDA allergen categories](https://www.fda.gov/food/buy-store-serve-safe-food/food-allergies-what-you-need-know).
Retain regional menu terms such as 'refill', 'filet mignon', 'tofu suave', 'cátsup', 'cacahuate', 'soya', and 'ajonjolí'. Keep 'alioli' consistently; write the recognizable sauce name as 'ají verde'.

Use 'zacate limón' for lemongrass, an established Mexican name documented by [Larousse](https://laroussecocina.mx/palabra/te-limon/). Use 'fideos finos' for vermicelli and 'fideos de cristal' for glass noodles without inventing their ingredients.

Retain 'huevo tibio' for soft-boiled egg; it is established Mexican culinary usage. Keep soft-boiled, poached, and fried preparations distinct. See [Larousse](https://laroussecocina.mx/palabra/huevo-tibio-o-huevo-mollet/).

Use sentence capitalization while retaining recognizable proper names. Format times as 'a. m.' and 'p. m.'; preserve US decimal prices. See [Fundéu](https://fundeu.do/a-m-y-p-m-en-minuscula-y-con-punto/).

Length recommendations are based on the strings, not a rendered layout. Existing price labels are at most 19 characters. Let longer allergen qualifications wrap instead of shortening them into an allergen-free claim.
